sources.teams: TECHNICAL_SPEC §19: dois times 11×11 de JSON, forte (~70) e fraco (~50). Mean of the outfield attributes 1-14 of outfield players and of the 4 GK attributes of the keeper
sources.batch: TECHNICAL_SPEC §19 aceite: o forte vence a maioria em 200 headless, com algumas zebras. The CLI test runs a 100-match batch (deterministic seed) and requires a strict majority of strong wins plus some weak wins; dotnet/MatchReport prints the full 200-match report (X-58: 58% / 35% / 7%)
sources.sensitivity: TECHNICAL_SPEC §19 aceite: mudar Velocidade/Passe/Finalização move o relatório na direção esperada. Checked here for Velocidade+Agilidade with a large delta (the clearest effect); dotnet/MatchReport prints all three
